            --font-display: 'Syne', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
            --title-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(0.85rem, 2vw, 1.3rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            --table-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.85vw, 0.75rem);
            --caption-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        /* Responsive breakpoints */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.9rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.85rem, 2.5vw, 1.2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root {
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem);
            }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BACKGROUND PATTERNS
           =========================================== */
        .grid-bg {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
        }

        .gradient-mesh {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 80%, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 20%, rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.6s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-left {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.3); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.5); }
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-blue));
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(12px, 2vw, 24px);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            z-index: 999;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 12px);
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.5);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(12px, 2vh, 24px);
            left: clamp(16px, 3vw, 40px);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 70%, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.1) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 30%, rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.07) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .title-slide .title-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.25em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem);
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 30%, var(--accent-cyan) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .title-slide .subtitle {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: min(80vw, 750px);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 2vh, 2rem);
        }

        .title-slide .source-ref {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .title-slide .source-ref a {
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        /* Decorative corner accents */
        .corner-accent {
            position: absolute;
            width: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            height: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            border-color: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2);
            border-style: solid;
        }
        .corner-accent.tl { top: clamp(20px, 3vh, 40px); left: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px); border-width: 2px 0 0 2px; }
        .corner-accent.br { bottom: clamp(20px, 3vh, 40px); right: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px); border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE HEADERS
           =========================================== */
        .slide-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .slide-header h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .slide-header .accent-line {
            width: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM - FLOOD IRRIGATION
           =========================================== */
        .problem-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .paradigm-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .paradigm-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .paradigm-card.imitation::before { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .paradigm-card.trial::before { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .paradigm-card.knowledge::before { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .paradigm-card .card-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            right: clamp(8px, 1vw, 16px);
        }

        .paradigm-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .paradigm-card .examples {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .paradigm-card .issue {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .vs-human {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .vs-human .icon-brain {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .vs-human p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES
           =========================================== */
        .flow-diagram {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .flow-origin {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .flow-connector-down {
            width: 2px;
            height: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            position: relative;
        }

        .flow-connector-down::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-left: 6px solid transparent;
            border-right: 6px solid transparent;
            border-top: 8px solid var(--accent-blue);
        }

        .flow-branch-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            width: 100%;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .flow-branch-line {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            max-width: clamp(180px, 28vw, 320px);
        }

        .flow-criterion {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .flow-criterion .criterion-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
        }

        .flow-criterion .criterion-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .flow-connector-branch {
            width: 2px;
            height: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .flow-connector-branch.fast { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .flow-connector-branch.slow { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .flow-connector-branch.know { background: var(--accent-purple); }

        .thinking-card {
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            width: 100%;
            position: relative;
        }

        .thinking-card.fast {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.12), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.04));
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.35);
        }

        .thinking-card.slow {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.12), rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.04));
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.35);
        }

        .thinking-card.know {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.12), rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.04));
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.35);
        }

        .thinking-card .mode-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
        }

        .thinking-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
        }

        .thinking-card.fast h3 { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .thinking-card.slow h3 { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .thinking-card.know h3 { color: var(--accent-purple); }

        .thinking-card .mode-desc {
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .thinking-card .token-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.65rem);
            padding: clamp(1px, 0.2vw, 3px) clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .thinking-card.fast .token-tag { background: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .thinking-card.slow .token-tag { background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .thinking-card.know .token-tag { background: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.2); color: var(--accent-purple); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: FRAMEWORK PIPELINE
           =========================================== */
        .pipeline-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .pipeline-steps {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .pipeline-step {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pipeline-step::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .pipeline-step.step1::before { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .pipeline-step.step2::before { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .pipeline-step.step3::before { background: var(--accent-purple); }

        .pipeline-step .step-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .pipeline-step.step1 .step-number { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .pipeline-step.step2 .step-number { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .pipeline-step.step3 .step-number { color: var(--accent-purple); }

        .pipeline-step h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .pipeline-step .step-detail {
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .pipeline-step .step-detail strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .pipeline-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
        }

        .pipeline-arrow .arrow-shape {
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-top: 8px solid transparent;
            border-bottom: 8px solid transparent;
            border-left: 12px solid var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .framework-image-container {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .framework-image-container img {
            max-height: min(35vh, 280px);
            max-width: 90%;
            object-fit: contain;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
           =========================================== */
        .examples-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .example-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .example-card .task-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .example-card .comparison-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .example-card .comparison-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        .comparison-item.baseline {
            background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.08);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-red);
        }

        .comparison-item.knowself {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.08);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .comparison-item .method-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            min-width: clamp(50px, 7vw, 80px);
        }

        .comparison-item.baseline .method-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .comparison-item.knowself .method-label { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        .comparison-item .method-detail {
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .comparison-item .method-detail .token-ref {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

    <section class="slide grid-bg gradient-mesh" id="slide-2">

                <div class="accent-line"></div>
            </div>
            <p class="reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.15s; font-size: var(--body-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem); line-height: 1.5;">
                Existing approaches indiscriminately inject gold trajectories, external feedback, or domain knowledge — regardless of whether the agent needs them at each step.
            </p>
            <div class="problem-grid">
                <div class="paradigm-card imitation reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.2s;">
                    <span class="card-number">01</span>
                    <h3>Trajectory Imitation</h3>
                    <p class="examples">e.g. ReAct</p>
                    <p class="issue">Blindly copies gold action sequences — fragile when inputs deviate from training distribution.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="paradigm-card trial reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.35s;">
                    <span class="card-number">02</span>
                    <h3>Trial-and-Error Refinement</h3>
                    <p class="examples">e.g. Reflexion, ETO</p>

                </div>
                <div class="paradigm-card knowledge reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.5s;">
                    <span class="card-number">03</span>
                    <h3>Knowledge-Augmented</h3>

                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="vs-human reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.65s;">
                <span class="icon-brain">🧠</span>

            </div>

                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="pipeline-arrow reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.25s;">
                        <div class="arrow-shape"></div>
                    </div>

                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="pipeline-arrow reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.45s;">
                        <div class="arrow-shape"></div>
                    </div>

                        <div class="step-number">Step 3</div>

                        </div>
                    </div>

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.scrollTimeout = null;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (index !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = index;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const deltaX = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;

                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX) && Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        if (deltaY > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupMouseWheel() {
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    this.isScrolling = true;

                    if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    else if (e.deltaY < 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);

                    clearTimeout(this.scrollTimeout);
                    this.scrollTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        this.isScrolling = false;
                    }, 800);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                if (!bar) return;
                this.progressBar = bar;
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!container) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.classList.add('nav-dot');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .title-slide .source-ref a {
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        /* Decorative corner accents */
        .corner-accent {
            position: absolute;
            width: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            height: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            border-color: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2);
            border-style: solid;
        }
        .corner-accent.tl { top: clamp(20px, 3vh, 40px); left: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px); border-width: 2px 0 0 2px; }
        .corner-accent.br { bottom: clamp(20px, 3vh, 40px); right: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px); border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE HEADERS
           =========================================== */
        .slide-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .slide-header h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .slide-header .accent-line {
            width: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM - FLOOD IRRIGATION
           =========================================== */
        .problem-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .paradigm-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .paradigm-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .paradigm-card.imitation::before { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .paradigm-card.trial::before { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .paradigm-card.knowledge::before { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .paradigm-card .card-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            right: clamp(8px, 1vw, 16px);
        }

        .paradigm-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .paradigm-card .examples {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .paradigm-card .issue {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .vs-human {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .vs-human .icon-brain {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .vs-human p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES
           =========================================== */
        .flow-diagram {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .flow-origin {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .flow-connector-down {
            width: 2px;
            height: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            position: relative;
        }

        .flow-connector-down::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-left: 6px solid transparent;
            border-right: 6px solid transparent;
            border-top: 8px solid var(--accent-blue);
        }

        .flow-branch-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            width: 100%;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .flow-branch-line {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            max-width: clamp(180px, 28vw, 320px);
        }

        .flow-criterion {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .flow-criterion .criterion-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
        }

        .flow-criterion .criterion-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .flow-connector-branch {
            width: 2px;
            height: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .flow-connector-branch.fast { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .flow-connector-branch.slow { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .flow-connector-branch.know { background: var(--accent-purple); }

        .thinking-card {
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            width: 100%;
            position: relative;
        }

        .thinking-card.fast {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.12), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.04));
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.35);
        }

        .thinking-card.slow {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.12), rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.04));
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.35);
        }

        .thinking-card.know {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.12), rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.04));
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.35);
        }

        .thinking-card .mode-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
        }

        .thinking-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
        }

        .thinking-card.fast h3 { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .thinking-card.slow h3 { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .thinking-card.know h3 { color: var(--accent-purple); }

        .thinking-card .mode-desc {
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .thinking-card .token-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.65rem);
            padding: clamp(1px, 0.2vw, 3px) clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .thinking-card.fast .token-tag { background: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2); color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .thinking-card.slow .token-tag { background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .thinking-card.know .token-tag { background: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.2); color: var(--accent-purple); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: FRAMEWORK PIPELINE
           =========================================== */
        .pipeline-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .pipeline-steps {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .pipeline-step {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pipeline-step::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .pipeline-step.step1::before { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .pipeline-step.step2::before { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .pipeline-step.step3::before { background: var(--accent-purple); }

        .pipeline-step .step-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .pipeline-step.step1 .step-number { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .pipeline-step.step2 .step-number { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .pipeline-step.step3 .step-number { color: var(--accent-purple); }

        .pipeline-step h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .pipeline-step .step-detail {
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .pipeline-step .step-detail strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .pipeline-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
        }

        .pipeline-arrow .arrow-shape {
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-top: 8px solid transparent;
            border-bottom: 8px solid transparent;
            border-left: 12px solid var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .framework-image-container {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .framework-image-container img {
            max-height: min(35vh, 280px);
            max-width: 90%;
            object-fit: contain;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
           =========================================== */
        .examples-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .example-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .example-card .task-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .example-card .comparison-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .example-card .comparison-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        .comparison-item.baseline {
            background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.08);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-red);
        }

        .comparison-item.knowself {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.08);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .comparison-item .method-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            min-width: clamp(50px, 7vw, 80px);
        }

        .comparison-item.baseline .method-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .comparison-item.knowself .method-label { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        .comparison-item .method-detail {
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .comparison-item .method-detail .token-ref {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.75vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .token-ref.reflection { background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2); color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .token-ref.knowledge { background: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.2); color: var(--accent-purple); }

        .figure-container {
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .figure-container img {
            max-height: min(30vh, 220px);
            max-width: 95%;
            object-fit: contain;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .figure-container .figure-caption {
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
            font-style: italic;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: ALFWorld RESULTS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .results-table-wrapper {
            overflow: hidden;
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .results-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 0;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--table-size);
        }

        .results-table thead th {
            background: var(--table-header-bg);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            padding: clamp(3px, 0.4vh, 6px) clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            white-space: nowrap;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
        }

        .results-table thead th:first-child {
            text-align: left;
        }

        .results-table thead th:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
        }

        .results-table tbody td {
            padding: clamp(2px, 0.3vh, 5px) clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .results-table tbody td:first-child {
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .results-table tbody td:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .results-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--table-row-bg); }
        .results-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: var(--table-row-alt); }

        .results-table tbody tr.group-header td {
            background: rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            padding: clamp(3px, 0.4vh, 5px) clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.2);
        }

        .results-table tbody tr.knowself-row {
            background: rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.08) !important;
        }

        .results-table tbody tr.knowself-row td {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table tbody tr.knowself-row td:nth-child(2) {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .results-table tbody tr.knowself-row td:last-child {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .know-pct-full {
            color: var(--accent-amber) !important;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .know-pct-low {
            color: var(--accent-cyan) !important;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .results-highlight {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .highlight-chip {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            background: var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2);
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.4rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .highlight-chip .chip-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: EFFICIENCY BAR CHART
           =========================================== */
        .efficiency-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            flex: 1;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .chart-section {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .chart-section h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .chart-section h3.cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .chart-section h3.amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .bar-group {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(60px, 10vw, 100px);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(14px, 2.2vh, 22px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding-right: clamp(3px, 0.3vw, 6px);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.45rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .bar-fill.knowledge-full {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.6), rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.9));
        }

        .bar-fill.knowledge-low {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.6), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.9));
        }

        .bar-fill.accuracy {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.5), rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.85));
        }

        .bar-fill.accuracy-best {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.5), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.9));
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .efficiency-divider {
            width: 2px;
            background: var(--border-color);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .scaling-note {
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            background: var(--accent-cyan-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.2);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--caption-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .scaling-note strong { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: KEY TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaways-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            flex: 1;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item .takeaway-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1.1rem);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            min-width: clamp(20px, 2.5vw, 30px);
        }

            font-size: var(--body-size);

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.scrollTimeout = null;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (index !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = index;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

    <section class="slide grid-bg gradient-mesh" id="slide-2">

                <div class="accent-line"></div>
            </div>
            <p class="reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.15s; font-size: var(--body-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem); line-height: 1.5;">
                Existing approaches indiscriminately inject gold trajectories, external feedback, or domain knowledge — regardless of whether the agent needs them at each step.
            </p>
            <div class="problem-grid">
                <div class="paradigm-card imitation reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.2s;">
                    <span class="card-number">01</span>
                    <h3>Trajectory Imitation</h3>
                    <p class="examples">e.g. ReAct</p>
                    <p class="issue">Blindly copies gold action sequences — fragile when inputs deviate from training distribution.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="paradigm-card trial reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.35s;">
                    <span class="card-number">02</span>
                    <h3>Trial-and-Error Refinement</h3>
                    <p class="examples">e.g. Reflexion, ETO</p>
                    <p class="issue">Always reflects, even when unnecessary — wastes compute and can introduce spurious corrections.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="paradigm-card knowledge reveal" style="transition-delay: 0.5s;">
                    <span class="card-number">03</span>
                    <h3>Knowledge-Augmented</h3>
                    <p class="examples">e.g. KnowAgent, WKM, ExpeL</p>

                </div>

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.scrollTimeout = null;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (index !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = index;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const deltaX = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;

                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX) && Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        if (deltaY > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupMouseWheel() {
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    this.isScrolling = true;

                    if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    else if (e.deltaY < 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);

                    clearTimeout(this.scrollTimeout);
                    this.scrollTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        this.isScrolling = false;
                    }, 800);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                if (!bar) return;
                this.progressBar = bar;
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!container) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.classList.add('nav-dot');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
